description.value: Over a long rest, using audiotech's implements, you rework an instrument into your own creation. It becomes an enhanced item usable only by you, requires attunement, and serves as a tech focus for your tech powers while attuned. It starts with 4 modification slots, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each modification beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may install, swap, or remove modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), and any effect requiring a save uses your tech save DC.
